capabilities: subscription-tracking | Records recurring subscriptions with price, currency, billing cycle, category and payment method in a web interface, and shows upcoming payments and monthly or yearly totals.
description:
UnitySVC runs the official Wallos image in a separate container for each enrollment, with its own HTTPS address. Wallos is a self-hosted personal subscription tracker: you enter your recurring subscriptions with their price, currency, billing cycle, category and payment method, and it shows what is due next and what they cost per month and per year. Everything is kept in the instance's own SQLite database and uploaded logos, stored in the `wallos` folder of your home, so it survives stopping the instance and even removing it and enrolling again.

Enroll in the base channel and choose the time zone Wallos uses for payment dates. Then open `https://<instance>/` and register at once: the first account Wallos sees becomes its administrator, and registration closes after that. You can run one Wallos instance at a time. See How to use this service for full setup and limitations.

You pay the selected channel's platform compute cost while the instance runs, including idle time, and the platform keeps the data in your home while it is stopped. Labs adds no markup and receives no seller payout. See the upstream Wallos documentation and issue tracker for software-specific help.
